# ankra_organisation_role (Resource)

A custom organisation role (`ankra org roles`): a named set of permissions, and optionally Kubernetes access grants, that members and service accounts can be given. Changing `name`, `description`, `permissions` or `kube_grants` updates the role in place, and every member holding it gets the new permissions. Destroy retires the role, which the platform refuses while anyone still holds it. Managing roles needs `members.manage`; a role may not carry permissions the caller lacks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_organisation_role" "deployer" {
  slug        = "deployer"
  name        = "Deployer"
  description = "Ships applications to the apps namespace"
  permissions = ["clusters.read", "applications.read", "applications.write"]

  kube_grants = [{
    scope     = "namespace"
    namespace = "apps"
    k8s_role  = "edit"
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the role.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permissions the role grants, such as `clusters.read` or `applications.write`. An apply keeps the configured set; a refresh reports the set the platform stores.
- `slug` (String) Slug members are assigned the role by, unique in the organisation. The platform never changes it, so changing it replaces the role.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `kube_grants` (Attributes Set) Kubernetes access the role grants through the kube gateway. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kube_grants))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the role.

<a id="nestedatt--kube_grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kube_grants`

Required:

- `k8s_role` (String) Kubernetes role bound: `view`, `edit`, `admin` or `cluster-admin`.
- `scope` (String) `cluster` or `namespace`.

Optional:

- `namespace` (String) Namespace of a `namespace` grant.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by role id or slug.
terraform import ankra_organisation_role.deployer deployer
```
